records.issue_text: Saving a new host without a category persists it as Uncategorized but overwrites the client-side category with findById(null), leaving the UI blank until reload
records.rationale: The finding is verifiable from the diff. In embeddable-host.js.es6 line 36-37, after save() succeeds, it calls `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`.
